#!/usr/bin/env python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
OCR 转换脚本
用法: python ocr_convert.py <PDF路径> [输出目录]
功能: 使用 Marker 对扫描PDF做OCR，输出 .txt 文件（保留公式LaTeX、表格）
模型缓存: D:\ocr_models\
"""

import os
import sys
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

# ========== 设置模型缓存到D盘 + 国内镜像 ==========
os.environ["HF_HOME"] = r"D:\ocr_models\hf"
os.environ["SURYA_CACHE_DIR"] = r"D:\ocr_models\surya"
os.environ["TORCH_HOME"] = r"D:\ocr_models\torch"
os.environ["HF_ENDPOINT"] = "https://hf-mirror.com"

def main():
    # ---- 参数处理 ----
    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
        print("用法: drag & drop PDF 到 ocr_convert.bat 上")
        print("   或: python ocr_convert.py <PDF路径> [输出目录]")
        input("\n按回车键退出...")
        sys.exit(1)

    pdf_path = sys.argv[1]
    if not os.path.isfile(pdf_path):
        print(f"❌ 文件不存在: {pdf_path}")
        input("\n按回车键退出...")
        sys.exit(1)

    pdf_name = Path(pdf_path).stem
    pdf_dir = Path(pdf_path).parent

    # 输出目录：默认在PDF同目录下创建 "PDF名_ocr"
    if len(sys.argv) >= 3:
        out_dir = Path(sys.argv[2])
    else:
        out_dir = pdf_dir / f"{pdf_name}_ocr_txt"

    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    # ---- 临时目录（Marker的工作目录）----
    temp_dir = out_dir / "_temp_md"
    if temp_dir.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(temp_dir)

    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
    print(f"📄 PDF: {pdf_path}")
    print(f"📁 输出: {out_dir}\\")
    print(f"{'='*60}\n")

    # ---- 导入并运行 Marker ----
    try:
        from marker.converters.pdf import PdfConverter
        from marker.models import create_model_dict
        from marker.output import text_from_rendered

        # 加载模型（首次会自动从HF下载 ~2GB 到 D:\ocr_models\）
        print("🔄 加载OCR模型（首次约2GB下载，之后秒加载）...")
        model_dict = create_model_dict()

        converter = PdfConverter(
            model_dict=model_dict,
        )

        print(f"🔄 开始识别（约5-10秒/页，共920页约2.5小时）...")
        rendered = converter(pdf_path)

        # 提取纯文本
        text, _, _ = text_from_rendered(rendered)

        # 保存为 .txt
        txt_path = out_dir / f"{pdf_name}.txt"
        with open(txt_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(text)

        file_size_mb = os.path.getsize(txt_path) / 1024 / 1024
        print(f"\n✅ 转换完成!")
        print(f"   📄 {txt_path} ({file_size_mb:.1f} MB)")
        print(f"   📊 总字符: {len(text):,}")

    except ImportError as e:
        print(f"\n❌ Marker 未安装！请先运行 ocr_install.bat")
        print(f"   错误: {e}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"\n❌ 转换出错: {e}")
        import traceback
        traceback.print_exc()
    finally:
        # 清理临时目录
        if temp_dir.exists():
            shutil.rmtree(temp_dir)

    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
    print(f"  完成！按回车键退出...")
    input()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
Model installer for Marker OCR.
If you downloaded model files via Thunder, put them in:
    D:\ocr_downloads\

The script will detect and arrange them correctly.
"""

import os
import sys
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

os.environ["HF_HOME"] = r"D:\ocr_models\hf"
os.environ["SURYA_CACHE_DIR"] = r"D:\ocr_models\surya"
os.environ["HF_ENDPOINT"] = "https://hf-mirror.com"

HF_CACHE = Path(r"D:\ocr_models\hf")
DOWNLOAD_DIR = Path(r"D:\ocr_downloads")

REPOS = [
    "datalab-to/surya_det3",
    "datalab-to/surya_layout3", 
    "datalab-to/surya_rec2",
    "datalab-to/surya_order",
    "datalab-to/surya_tablerec",
    "datalab-to/texify",
]

def hf_cache_dir(repo_id: str) -> Path:
    """Convert repo ID to HuggingFace cache path."""
    safe = repo_id.replace("/", "--")
    return HF_CACHE / "hub" / f"models--{safe}"

def download_small_files(repo_id: str):
    """Download all small config files via HF hub (fast)."""
    from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download, HfApi
    api = HfApi()
    
    cache = hf_cache_dir(repo_id)
    print(f"\n  Checking {repo_id}...")
    
    try:
        # Get repo info to find commit hash
        info = api.repo_info(repo_id, repo_type="model")
        commit = info.sha
        print(f"  Commit: {commit[:8]}")
        
        # Create cache structure
        refs_dir = cache / "refs"
        refs_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (refs_dir / "main").write_text(commit)
        
        snapshots_dir = cache / "snapshots" / commit
        snapshots_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        
        # Get all files in the repo
        files = api.list_repo_files(repo_id, repo_type="model")
        
        for file in files:
            dest = snapshots_dir / file
            
            if file.endswith(".safetensors"):
                # Big model file - only set up if already downloaded
                local_file = DOWNLOAD_DIR / file
                if local_file.exists():
                    print(f"    Found Thunder-downloaded: {file}")
                    shutil.copy2(local_file, dest)
                    print(f"    Copied! ({local_file.stat().st_size / 1024 / 1024:.0f} MB)")
                else:
                    half_file = DOWNLOAD_DIR / f"{file}.part"
                    if half_file.exists():
                        print(f"    Found partial: {file}.part -> renaming to {file}")
                        half_file.rename(dest)
                    else:
                        print(f"    Need to download: {file} (put it in {DOWNLOAD_DIR})")
                        # Try a small download to create size placeholder
                        dest.touch()
            else:
                # Small config file - download directly
                if not dest.exists():
                    url = f"https://hf-mirror.com/{repo_id}/resolve/main/{file}"
                    print(f"    Downloading config: {file}")
                    import requests
                    try:
                        r = requests.get(url, timeout=30)
                        if r.status_code == 200:
                            dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                            dest.write_bytes(r.content)
                            print(f"      Done ({len(r.content)} bytes)")
                        else:
                            print(f"      Failed: HTTP {r.status_code}")
                    except Exception as e:
                        print(f"      Error: {e}")
                else:
                    print(f"    Already cached: {file}")
                    
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  Error: {e}")

def download_all_models():
    """Main download/arrange function."""
    import requests
    
    print("=" * 60)
    print("Marker OCR Model Setup")
    print("=" * 60)
    print(f"\nModel cache: {HF_CACHE}")
    print(f"Thunder downloads folder: {DOWNLOAD_DIR}")
    
    # Create download dir if needed
    DOWNLOAD_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    
    print("\n[Step 1] Downloading small config files & setting up cache...")
    for repo in REPOS:
        download_small_files(repo)
    
    print("\n[Step 2] Checking for large model files...")
    missing = []
    for repo in REPOS:
        cache = hf_cache_dir(repo)
        try:
            ref = (cache / "refs" / "main").read_text().strip()
            snap = cache / "snapshots" / ref
            safetensors = list(snap.rglob("*.safetensors"))
            for st in safetensors:
                size = st.stat().st_size if st.exists() else 0
                if size < 1024:  # placeholder file
                    missing.append((repo, st.name, st))
                    print(f"  [MISSING] {repo}/{st.name}")
                else:
                    print(f"  [OK] {repo}/{st.name} ({size / 1024 / 1024:.0f} MB)")
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"  [ERROR] {repo}: {e}")
    
    if missing:
        print(f"\n{'=' * 60}")
        print(f"Still {len(missing)} model files missing.")
        print(f"\nOpen Thunder, download these URLs:")
        print(f"{'=' * 60}")
        for repo, fname, _ in missing:
            repo_path = repo.replace("/", "/").replace("datalab-to/", "")
            print(f"  https://hf-mirror.com/{repo}/resolve/main/{fname}")
        print(f"\nSave them to: {DOWNLOAD_DIR}")
        print("Then run this script again.")
    else:
        print(f"\n{'=' * 60}")
        print("All models ready! You can now use ocr_convert.bat")
        print("=" * 60)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    download_all_models()

from typing import Optional

import torch
from transformers.utils import is_flash_attn_2_available

from surya.common.load import ModelLoader
from surya.common.surya.config import SuryaModelConfig
from surya.common.surya import SuryaModel, SuryaXLAModel
from surya.common.surya.processor import SuryaOCRProcessor
from surya.common.surya.processor.tokenizer import SuryaOCRTokenizer
from surya.common.util import is_flash_attn_2_supported
from surya.common.xla import get_compile_args
from surya.logging import get_logger
from surya.settings import settings

logger = get_logger()


class FoundationModelLoader(ModelLoader):
    def __init__(self, checkpoint: Optional[str] = None):
        super().__init__(checkpoint)

        if self.checkpoint is None:
            self.checkpoint = settings.FOUNDATION_MODEL_CHECKPOINT

    def model(
        self,
        device=settings.TORCH_DEVICE_MODEL,
        dtype=None,
        attention_implementation: Optional[str] = None,
    ) -> SuryaModel:
        if device is None:
            device = settings.TORCH_DEVICE_MODEL
        if dtype is None:
            # See https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/issues/118122 - T4 (device version 7.5) will return true since it supports
            # emulated bf16, but falls back to very slow kernels, especially for SDPA
            dtype = settings.MODEL_DTYPE_BFLOAT
            if device == "cuda" and not torch.cuda.is_bf16_supported(
                including_emulation=False
            ):
                # If the device is cuda, we check if bf16 is supported, and if not, we use float16
                dtype = settings.MODEL_DTYPE
        elif dtype == torch.float16:
            dtype = torch.bfloat16  # Model weights in bfloat16

        config = SuryaModelConfig.from_pretrained(self.checkpoint)

        if attention_implementation is not None:
            config.decoder._attn_implementation = attention_implementation
            config.vision_encoder._attn_implementation = attention_implementation
        elif is_flash_attn_2_available() and is_flash_attn_2_supported(device):
            config.decoder._attn_implementation = "flash_attention_2"
            config.vision_encoder._attn_implementation = "flash_attention_2"
        elif device == "xla":
            config.decoder._attn_implementation = "sdpa"
            config.vision_encoder._attn_implementation = "sdpa"
        else:
            config.decoder._attn_implementation = "sdpa"
            config.vision_encoder._attn_implementation = "sdpa"

        model_cls = SuryaModel
        if device == "xla":
            model_cls = SuryaXLAModel

        config._attn_implementation_autoset = True
        config.vision_encoder._attn_implementation_autoset = True
        config.decoder._attn_implementation_autoset = True

        model = model_cls.from_pretrained(
            self.checkpoint, dtype=dtype, config=config, ignore_mismatched_sizes=True
        ).to(device)
        model = model.eval()

        if settings.COMPILE_ALL or settings.COMPILE_FOUNDATION:
            torch._dynamo.config.cache_size_limit = 1000
            torch._dynamo.config.suppress_errors = True
            torch._dynamo.config.specialize_int = False
            torch._dynamo.config.allow_unspec_int_on_nn_module = True
            torch._dynamo.config.capture_scalar_outputs = True
            torch._dynamo.config.recompile_limit = 32

            logger.info(
                f"Compiling foundation model {self.checkpoint} on device {device} with dtype {dtype}"
            )
            compile_args = get_compile_args(device)
            model.vision_encoder = torch.compile(model.vision_encoder, **compile_args)
            model.decoder = torch.compile(model.decoder, **compile_args)

        logger.debug(
            f"Loaded recognition model {self.checkpoint} from {SuryaModel.get_local_path(self.checkpoint)} onto device {model.device} with dtype {dtype}, using decoder attention mechanism {model.config.decoder._attn_implementation}, encoder attention mechanism {model.config.vision_encoder._attn_implementation}."
        )
        return model

    def processor(
        self, device=settings.TORCH_DEVICE_MODEL, dtype=settings.MODEL_DTYPE_BFLOAT
    ) -> SuryaOCRProcessor:
        config: SuryaModelConfig = SuryaModelConfig.from_pretrained(self.checkpoint)

        ocr_tokenizer = SuryaOCRTokenizer(
            special_tokens=config.special_ocr_tokens, model_checkpoint=self.checkpoint
        )

        processor = SuryaOCRProcessor(
            ocr_tokenizer=ocr_tokenizer,
            blank_bbox_token_id=config.blank_bbox_token_id,
            num_register_tokens=config.num_register_tokens,
            sequence_length=None,
            patch_size=config.vision_encoder.patch_size,
            merge_size=config.vision_encoder.spatial_merge_size,
            model_device=device,
            num_beacon_tokens=config.num_beacon_tokens,
            beacon_token_interval=config.beacon_token_interval,
        )

        return processor

import json
import os
import shutil
import tempfile
import time
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from pathlib import Path

import requests
from tqdm import tqdm

from surya.logging import get_logger
from surya.settings import settings

logger = get_logger()

# Lock file expiration time in seconds (10 minutes)
LOCK_EXPIRATION = 600


def join_urls(url1: str, url2: str):
    url1 = url1.rstrip("/")
    url2 = url2.lstrip("/")
    return f"{url1}/{url2}"


def get_model_name(pretrained_model_name_or_path: str):
    return pretrained_model_name_or_path.split("/")[0]


def download_file(remote_path: str, local_path: str, chunk_size: int = 1024 * 1024):
    local_path = Path(local_path)
    try:
        response = requests.get(remote_path, stream=True, allow_redirects=True)
        response.raise_for_status()  # Raise an exception for bad status codes

        # Get file size from headers for progress bar
        total_size = int(response.headers.get('content-length', 0))
        
        # Create progress bar with file name and size info
        filename = local_path.name
        pbar = tqdm(
            total=total_size,
            unit='B',
            unit_scale=True,
            unit_divisor=1024,
            desc=f"Downloading {filename}",
            miniters=1
        )

        with open(local_path, "wb") as f:
            downloaded = 0
            for chunk in response.iter_content(chunk_size=chunk_size):
                if chunk:
                    f.write(chunk)
                    downloaded += len(chunk)
                    pbar.update(len(chunk))
        
        pbar.close()
        return local_path
    except Exception as e:
        if local_path.exists():
            local_path.unlink()
        logger.error(f"Download error for file {remote_path}: {str(e)}")
        raise


def check_manifest(local_dir: str):
    local_dir = Path(local_dir)
    manifest_path = local_dir / "manifest.json"
    if not os.path.exists(manifest_path):
        return False

    try:
        with open(manifest_path, "r") as f:
            manifest = json.load(f)
        for file in manifest["files"]:
            if not os.path.exists(local_dir / file):
                return False
    except Exception:
        return False

    return True


def download_directory(remote_path: str, local_dir: str):
    model_name = get_model_name(remote_path)
    s3_url = join_urls(settings.S3_BASE_URL, remote_path)
    # Check to see if it's already downloaded
    model_exists = check_manifest(local_dir)
    if model_exists:
        return

    # Use tempfile.TemporaryDirectory to automatically clean up
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp_dir:
        # Download the manifest file
        manifest_file = join_urls(s3_url, "manifest.json")
        manifest_path = os.path.join(temp_dir, "manifest.json")
        download_file(manifest_file, manifest_path)

        # List and download all files
        with open(manifest_path, "r") as f:
            manifest = json.load(f)

        pbar = tqdm(
            desc=f"Downloading {model_name} model to {local_dir}",
            total=len(manifest["files"]),
        )

        with ThreadPoolExecutor(
            max_workers=settings.PARALLEL_DOWNLOAD_WORKERS
        ) as executor:
            futures = []
            for file in manifest["files"]:
                remote_file = join_urls(s3_url, file)
                local_file = os.path.join(temp_dir, file)
                futures.append(executor.submit(download_file, remote_file, local_file))

            for future in futures:
                future.result()
                pbar.update(1)

        pbar.close()

        # Move all files to new directory
        for file in os.listdir(temp_dir):
            shutil.move(os.path.join(temp_dir, file), local_dir)


class S3DownloaderMixin:
    s3_prefix = "s3://"

    @classmethod
    def get_local_path(cls, pretrained_model_name_or_path) -> str:
        if pretrained_model_name_or_path.startswith(cls.s3_prefix):
            pretrained_model_name_or_path = pretrained_model_name_or_path.replace(
                cls.s3_prefix, ""
            )
            cache_dir = settings.MODEL_CACHE_DIR
            local_path = os.path.join(cache_dir, pretrained_model_name_or_path)
            os.makedirs(local_path, exist_ok=True)
        else:
            local_path = ""
        return local_path

    @classmethod
    def from_pretrained(cls, pretrained_model_name_or_path, *args, **kwargs):
        # Allow loading models directly from the hub, or using s3
        if not pretrained_model_name_or_path.startswith(cls.s3_prefix):
            return super().from_pretrained(
                pretrained_model_name_or_path, *args, **kwargs
            )

        local_path = cls.get_local_path(pretrained_model_name_or_path)
        pretrained_model_name_or_path = pretrained_model_name_or_path.replace(
            cls.s3_prefix, ""
        )

        # Retry logic for downloading the model folder
        retries = 3
        delay = 5
        attempt = 0
        success = False
        while not success and attempt < retries:
            try:
                download_directory(pretrained_model_name_or_path, local_path)
                success = True  # If download succeeded
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(
                    f"Error downloading model from {pretrained_model_name_or_path}. Attempt {attempt + 1} of {retries}. Error: {e}"
                )
                attempt += 1
                if attempt < retries:
                    logger.info(f"Retrying in {delay} seconds...")
                    time.sleep(delay)  # Wait before retrying
                else:
                    logger.error(
                        f"Failed to download {pretrained_model_name_or_path} after {retries} attempts."
                    )
                    raise e  # Reraise exception after max retries

        return super().from_pretrained(local_path, *args, **kwargs)

#!/usr/bin/env python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
Marker OCR 下载器
直接从官方 S3 下载（比 HF 国内镜像快 10x）
支持断点续传
"""

import os, sys, json, time, shutil
from pathlib import Path
import requests

S3 = "https://models.datalab.to"
CACHE = Path(r"D:\ocr_models\datalab\Cache\models")

# 所有模型
MODELS = [
    "layout/2025_09_23",              # ~1.35GB
    "text_recognition/2025_09_23",    # ~1.35GB
    "text_detection/2025_05_07",      # ~200MB
    "table_recognition/2025_02_18",   # ~200MB
    "ocr_error_detection/2025_02_18", # ~200MB
]

def fmt(n):
    for u in ['B','KB','MB','GB']:
        if n < 1024: return f"{n:.1f}{u}"
        n /= 1024

def main():
    print("=" * 55)
    print("  Marker OCR 下载器")
    print(f"  S3 源: {S3}")
    print(f"  缓存: {CACHE}")
    print(f"  按住 ESC 可安全中断，下次续传")
    print("=" * 55)

    for mp in MODELS:
        local = CACHE / mp
        local.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        s3_url = f"{S3}/{mp}"

        # 获取 manifest
        try:
            r = requests.get(f"{s3_url}/manifest.json", timeout=15)
            manifest = r.json()
        except:
            print(f"\n❌ 无法连接 {mp}，跳过")
            continue

        files = manifest["files"]
        print(f"\n📦 {mp}  ({len(files)} files)")

        for fn in files:
            dest = local / fn
            ds = dest.stat().st_size if dest.exists() else 0

            # 检查是否已完成
            if dest.exists() and ds > 1024:
                # 特别检查 safetensors 完整性
                if fn.endswith(".safetensors") and ds > 1_000_000:
                    print(f"  ✓ {fn}  ({fmt(ds)})")
                    continue
                elif not fn.endswith(".safetensors"):
                    print(f"  ✓ {fn}")
                    continue

            url = f"{s3_url}/{fn}"
            resume = ds

            try:
                headers = {"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0"}
                if resume:
                    headers["Range"] = f"bytes={resume}-"

                r2 = requests.get(url, stream=True, timeout=30, headers=headers)
                if r2.status_code not in (200, 206):
                    print(f"  ✗ {fn}: HTTP {r2.status_code}")
                    continue

                total = int(r2.headers.get("content-length", 0)) + resume
                mode = "ab" if resume and r2.status_code == 206 else "wb"
                dl = resume if mode == "ab" else 0
                t0 = time.time()

                with open(dest, mode) as f:
                    for chunk in r2.iter_content(262144):
                        if chunk:
                            f.write(chunk)
                            dl += len(chunk)
                            now = time.time()
                            if now - t0 >= 2:
                                spd = dl / (now - t0)
                                pct = dl / total * 100 if total else 0
                                eta = (total - dl) / spd if spd > 0 else 0
                                print(f"\r  {'↻' if resume else '↓'} {fn}: {pct:.0f}%  "
                                      f"{fmt(dl)}/{fmt(total)}  {fmt(spd)}/s  "
                                      f"剩余{eta/60:.0f}分", end="")
                                sys.stdout.flush()
                                t0 = now

                print(f"\r  ✓ {fn}  ({fmt(dl)})  ")
            except KeyboardInterrupt:
                print(f"\n\n⏸ 已暂停，下次运行自动续传")
                return
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"\n  ✗ {fn}: {e}")
                # 保留部分文件以便续传

    print(f"\n{'='*55}")
    print("  全部完成！拖 PDF 到 ocr_convert.bat 即可使用")
    print(f"{'='*55}")
    input("\n按回车退出...")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        main()
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print("\n已退出")

#!/usr/bin/env python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
Marker OCR 下载器
直接从官方 S3 下载（比 HF 国内镜像快 10x）
支持断点续传
"""

import os, sys, json, time, shutil
from pathlib import Path
import requests

S3 = "https://models.datalab.to"
CACHE = Path(r"D:\ocr_models\datalab\Cache\models")

# 所有模型
MODELS = [
    "layout/2025_09_23",              # ~1.35GB
    "text_recognition/2025_09_23",    # ~1.35GB
    "text_detection/2025_05_07",      # ~200MB
    "table_recognition/2025_02_18",   # ~200MB
    "ocr_error_detection/2025_02_18", # ~200MB
]

def fmt(n):
    for u in ['B','KB','MB','GB']:
        if n < 1024: return f"{n:.1f}{u}"
        n /= 1024

def main():
    print("=" * 55)
    print("  Marker OCR 下载器")
    print(f"  S3 源: {S3}")
    print(f"  缓存: {CACHE}")
    print(f"  按住 ESC 可安全中断，下次续传")
    print("=" * 55)

    for mp in MODELS:
        local = CACHE / mp
        local.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        s3_url = f"{S3}/{mp}"

        # 获取 manifest
        try:
            r = requests.get(f"{s3_url}/manifest.json", timeout=15)
            manifest = r.json()
        except:
            print(f"\n❌ 无法连接 {mp}，跳过")
            continue

        files = manifest["files"]
        print(f"\n📦 {mp}  ({len(files)} files)")

        for fn in files:
            dest = local / fn
            ds = dest.stat().st_size if dest.exists() else 0

            # 检查是否已完成
            if dest.exists() and ds > 1024:
                # 特别检查 safetensors 完整性
                if fn.endswith(".safetensors") and ds > 1_000_000:
                    print(f"  ✓ {fn}  ({fmt(ds)})")
                    continue
                elif not fn.endswith(".safetensors"):
                    print(f"  ✓ {fn}")
                    continue

            url = f"{s3_url}/{fn}"
            resume = ds

            try:
                headers = {"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0"}
                if resume:
                    headers["Range"] = f"bytes={resume}-"

                r2 = requests.get(url, stream=True, timeout=30, headers=headers)
                if r2.status_code not in (200, 206):
                    print(f"  ✗ {fn}: HTTP {r2.status_code}")
                    continue

                total = int(r2.headers.get("content-length", 0)) + resume
                mode = "ab" if resume and r2.status_code == 206 else "wb"
                dl = resume if mode == "ab" else 0
                new_bytes = 0  # 只统计本次新下载的字节数
                t0 = time.time()

                with open(dest, mode) as f:
                    for chunk in r2.iter_content(262144):
                        if chunk:
                            f.write(chunk)
                            dl += len(chunk)
                            new_bytes += len(chunk)
                            now = time.time()
                            elapsed = now - t0
                            if elapsed >= 3:
                                spd = new_bytes / elapsed
                                pct = dl / total * 100 if total else 0
                                eta = (total - dl) / spd if spd > 0 else 0
                                print(f"\r  {'↻' if resume else '↓'} {fn}: {pct:.0f}%  "
                                      f"{fmt(dl)}/{fmt(total)}  {fmt(spd)}/s  "
                                      f"剩余{eta/60:.0f}分  ", end="")
                                sys.stdout.flush()
                                new_bytes = 0
                                t0 = now

                print(f"\r  ✓ {fn}  ({fmt(dl)})  ")
            except KeyboardInterrupt:
                print(f"\n\n⏸ 已暂停，下次运行自动续传")
                return
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"\n  ✗ {fn}: {e}")
                # 保留部分文件以便续传

    print(f"\n{'='*55}")
    print("  全部完成！拖 PDF 到 ocr_convert.bat 即可使用")
    print(f"{'='*55}")
    input("\n按回车退出...")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        main()
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print("\n已退出")
